I'd gladly put together a no-cost concept sample so you can judge the idea for yourself. Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

Hi Tanya,

I'm Roland Jacobs, a designer and book services specialist who helps authors present, publish and promote their books professionally.

I recently read the descriptions of This B Just Won't Die! and Cicada and wanted to reach out.

What stayed with me was Barbra Jacobs, a career Scream Queen of the Mirror film franchise — and, in Cicada, a rural horror film festival about a giant killer cicada. Those details gave me an idea for how a short book trailer could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. If it's useful, I can prepare a free concept sample to show the direction. Would that be of interest?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
